name: Videoman
biography: has 9+ years of experience doing computer security. He has worked for large enterprise financial institutions to secure their networks. Currently a computer security consultant, he enjoys working for NetSPI's clients to help them reduce their risks. In his spare time he and his wife run the local DefCon Group (DC612), and help to run the network at DefCon. He also likes to brew beer, and bike the many miles of pathways in Minnesota.
